QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Another Witness
QuestInfo.0: Wouldn't Sanaan have seen the same suspicious people that Aruhi saw? Talk to Sanaan at the General Store to find out.
QuestInfo.1: Wouldn't Sanaan have seen the same suspicious people that Aruhi saw? Talk to Sanaan at the General Store to find out.
QuestInfo.2: Sanaan said that she didn't see anyone suspicious, but she's kept a close watch on the Jellyrash and Giant Shadow. It seems the Giant Shadow creates the Jellyrash monsters, but there's a limit to how many it can create at once.
